Compare step labels between two restart solutions

Source: R/restarts.R
compare_ssf_solutions.Rd

Compare step labels between two restart solutions

Usage

compare_ssf_solutions(diagnostic, from = 1L, to = 2L)

Arguments

diagnostic

Output from diagnose_ssf_restarts().

from, to

Distinct solution numbers from diagnostic$solutions.

Value

An ssf_solution_comparison with a steps data frame in fitted observation order, a transitions count table, and posterior_from and posterior_to matrices with columns named by taxonomy label. The step table preserves observed columns, including coordinates and timestamps when supplied. Added columns are .step_index, .segment_step, .state_from, .state_to and .changed. .source_row identifies the row in the input as prepared by the fitting workflow. Keep original fix IDs in separate input columns.

See also

diagnose_ssf_restarts(), plot_ssf_changes()
